day_shape: 93 items: US strikes near Bandar Abbas with IRGC claiming retaliation against a US air base, IDF hits 150+ Lebanon targets and kills Hamas finance chief Khrizim, Trump says 'not satisfied' on Iran talks, Qalibaf re-elected speaker.

threads.label: US strikes near Bandar Abbas, IRGC claims response
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported US strikes on Iranian military sites for the second time this week, near Bandar Abbas airport. IRIB and Defa Press said the IRGC targeted a US air base at 04:50 in response, and Foreign Ministry spokesman Ismail Baghei condemned the strikes as a ceasefire violation.

threads.label: US-Iran talks: Trump 'not satisfied'
threads.summary: Trump told a cabinet meeting that Iran wanted a deal but the US was not satisfied, and ruled out sanctions relief in exchange for highly enriched uranium. The White House called an Iranian report of an MoU framework draft a 'complete fabrication', and the Telegraph reported hardliners trying to sabotage talks.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz, oil blockade and ship-to-ship transfers
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Iran fired on four ships attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz, and that Iran is evading sanctions via ship-to-ship transfers per the Wall Street Journal. Tanker Trackers estimated close to 60 million barrels of Iranian crude trapped by the US Navy blockade, while Trump said the US would 'blow up' Oman if it interfered.

threads.label: IDF Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah drone attack
threads.summary: The IDF struck over 150 targets across Lebanon including airstrikes on Tyre, and issued evacuation warnings for Tyre and Zuqaq al-Mufti. A Hezbollah drone killed Sgt. Rotem Yanai, 20, and wounded two reservists in northern Israel, with Israel's defence establishment developing counters to fiber-optic FPV drones.

threads.label: Hamas commanders killed in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said a Tuesday Khan Younis strike killed Ihab Khrizim, head of a central Hamas funds transfer network, alongside weapons production commander Mohammed al-Habash. Hamas confirmed the death of military chief Mohammed Odeh, with a funeral held in Gaza City.

threads.label: Iran domestic politics and Moscow diplomacy
threads.summary: Defa Press reported Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf re-elected as Parliament speaker, and IRIB said Ali Bagheri is leading Iran's delegation at a Moscow security officials meeting alongside around 120 countries. Bagheri met Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Georgy Borisenko and told RIA Novosti Iran's blocked assets must be returned unconditionally.

threads.label: Iranian-linked espionage suspicions in Israel
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported a major crimes detective from Israel's National Crime Unit Lahav 433 was questioned on suspicion of contact with a foreign agent, likely Iranian. Reports cited ongoing investigations into the alleged contact.

events.title_en: From the Marriott to the Cayena Hotel; beneath the skin of occupied Venezuela
events.summary_en: From the Marriott to the Cayena Hotel; beneath the skin of occupied Venezuela. Caracas's luxury hotels have recently become war rooms and informal US command centres for charting Venezuela's political and economic future. Four months after the abduction of Nicolás Maduro, Venezuela's former president, this South American nation is crossing 13 years of economic crisis and left-wing rule, now standing at a narrow threshold between 'economic revival under foreign capitalist guidance' and 'becoming the fifty-first state of America'. This situation combines the optimism of influential merchants with the growing anger of nationalists and working classes.

events.title_en: The 60mm mortar: an influential factor in close-range warfare
events.summary_en: The 60mm mortar: an influential factor in close-range warfare. The 60mm mortar is one of the lightest and most widely used types of mortar in the arsenals of military forces worldwide. This weapon plays a vital role in providing direct fire support due to its low weight, ease of transport by infantry, and appropriate destructive power for close targets. The 60mm mortar is typically distributed at the platoon or even infantry squad level. Unlike heavier mortars (such as 81 or 120mm) which require vehicles or large teams, a team of two to three people can carry this weapon and prepare it for firing in less than a few minutes. The main purpose of its deployment is the destruction of targets.

events.title_en: Urgent: We renew our urgent warning to residents of Lebanon present in the city of Nabatiyeh. In light of Hezbollah the terrorist committing a breach of the ceasefire agreement, the Defence Forces are forced to act against it with force. The Defence Forces do not intend to harm you. For your safety you must immediately evacuate your homes and move to north of the Litani River.
events.summary_en: Urgent: We renew our urgent warning to residents of Lebanon present in the city of Nabatiyeh. In light of Hezbollah the terrorist committing a breach of the ceasefire agreement, the Defence Forces are forced to act against it with force. The Defence Forces do not intend to harm you. For your safety you must immediately evacuate your homes and move to north of the Litani River. We confirm that anyone positioned close to Hezbollah elements and its facilities and combat means endangers his life.
